QuestInfo.name: Luke the Security Guy
QuestInfo.0: Meet Luke the Security Guy at the entrance of the Henesys Dungeon.
QuestInfo.1: At the entrance of the dungeon, you meet Luke the security guy. He wants to make a healthy dish for his mom and asks you to get him #b100 pieces of Jr. Necki's skin, 10 wings of Stirge, and a bowl of salad#k. He says he's too busy, but it looks like he's just napping on the job...
QuestInfo.2: You got Luke the stuff he asked for. Since he's making the Snake Drink... you want a taste, too! Luke gave you a nicely refined jewel he found from around the area. Anyway, you should drop by later when he's done making the Snake Drink.

0.0: Being a good son, I annually make my mom an extra special, healthy, and tasty dish, but I don't have as much time this year because of my job. Can you get the ingredients I need for my dish?

yes.0: Alright! This year I'm going to make my mom a tasty Snake Drink! Can you get me #b100 #t4000034#s#k, #b10 #t4000042#s#k, and for the final touch, #b1 #t2020000##k please?

no.0: Must be busy, eh? Can't blame you. I am, too. Let me know if you get any free time.

1.0: Oh my... Perfect! Now I can make the Snake Drink. It's a very rare drink so I'd never share it with anyone else, but I'll make an exception for you. When I'm done, drop by and share it with us, okay?
1.1: Since you worked hard to get me all those ingredients, I need to give you something in return. Now, what would be good...? Oh yeah! I've been collecting the shiny, sparkling objects found all around this area, but you can have this one!

yes.0: Got it? Thanks for the help. Now I must rush home. So long!

item.0: This year I'm trying to make my mom a very tasty Snake Drink! Can you get me #b100 #t4000034#s#k, #b10 #t4000042#s#k, and for the final touch, #b1 #t2020000##k please?
